thread:
sarah: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring latency spikes hit 99p on /v1/generate during two traffic bursts last week. Need clear owners, cohort-scoped SLO proposal, and tracking on the incident board.

devon: I can own the batching + queue caps. Found that long sequences (>1200 tokens) are causing head-of-line blocking. Plan: separate long-seq queue + cap batch size for it. PR will include metrics and a debug flag. ETA: Wed EOD.

marcus: I'll take dashboard and alert work. Split 95/99 alerts, add an error-budget burn panel, and create a 30m burn-rate alert. Will add runbook links to alert text. ETA: Thu morning.

infra-bot: Canary deployment started: opt-batcher v4 -> canary (10%) at 2026-04-02T01:12:10Z (sha: f7e8d9).

sarah: On the SLO tweak: prefer a cohort-based 5-7 day temporary adjustment only for model=X-large traffic (header X-Model). Avoid global SLO changes. Marcus can you draft the RFC including rollback criteria?

marcus: Yes. Draft will require 99p < 1.1s for 3h to revert and will include communication template for CS/PM. ETA: Fri.

devon: Batching note: I'll add sampling for long-tail latencies and a small qps-limiter for the long-seq queue to protect small requests; canary plan: 24h at 10% then 24h at 30% if stable.

ops: Incident I-7012 created and linked to the postmortem. Please update milestones and add "latency-pattern" tag if this recurs.

marcus: Draft alert rule (staging):
```
alert: ErrorBudgetBurnHigh
expr: increase(sum(rate(error_budget_spent_total[30m])) by (service), 0) > 2
for: 20m
labels:
  severity: page
```
I'll validate metric names and test Thursday in staging.

devon: PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/opt-batcher/pulls/88 (includes long-seq queue, batch caps, sampling).

sarah: Ownership summary: batching/queue+canary = devon; alerts+dashboard+RFC = marcus; SLO cohort drafting & comms = sarah. I'll drive cross-team notifications and confirm milestones on I-7012. Weekly ops sync Tuesday to review error-budget trend and canary results.

marcus: Posted staging dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/hijk9012/latency-burn (staging).

devon: Added tasks to I-7012 with canary schedule.

sarah: If anything pages before sync, tag it with "latency-pattern" and include the sequence-length metric in the page message. Keep updates short here.

infra-bot: Canary completed: opt-batcher v4 canary -> roll decision at 2026-04-02T03:20:00Z.

devon: Canary looks stable on 99p and queue wait for 10% window. Starting 30% ramp now.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Please post any blockers immediately.
